title: Camp Fire Aerial B-roll, Nov. 16, 2018
description: A UH-60M Black Hawk helicopter from the California Army National Guard's 1st Assault Helicopter Battalion, 140th Aviation Regiment, overflies and drops buckets of water on the northeast corner of the Camp Fire as it burns in the Feather River Canyon in Butte County, California, Friday, Nov. 16, 2018. Crew chief and U.S. Army Sgt. Anthony Orduno is seen preparing the water bucket and as the helicopter hovers over a dip site. The helicopter seen dropped 20 buckets of water on the fire Friday. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Senior Airman Crystal Housman)
